newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends steady in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends steady in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed steady at 41.30 to the dollar in the kerb market on Thursday but may be pushed down on Friday by a rising demand for the dollar, dealers said.

They said the demand for the rupee had dropped after the Karachi stock market dipped amid profit-taking. "A lot of rupee is likely to flow out of the stock market...into the dollar which is at the moment at an attractive level," one dealer said.
The State Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on July 11, was 40.5200/40.7226 rupees to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed steady at 2.20 percent.
